categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jufei Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the LED packaging industry, focusing on SMD LED product research, production, and sales. Key segments include backlight LEDs for mobile phones, computers, LCD TVs, display systems, automotive electronics, smart lighting, health monitoring, smart wearables, and optical sensing. The company is also expanding into automotive LEDs, Mini/Micro LED, infrared LEDs, high-end lighting, semiconductor packaging, optical coupling, optical devices, optical modules, and optical films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced LED packaging technologies including Mini LED and Micro LED for high brightness, high contrast, and precise color performance. It uses order-driven production with rolling material forecasts and digital management systems like JIT, BI, SAP, and MES for real-time data exchange and quality control. R&D focuses on ultra-thin, low light decay, high color rendering, and high reliability LED technologies, with over 750 patents including inventions. The company also integrates automated inspection equipment such as AOI and SPI and develops optical films and semiconductor packaging technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jufei serves major domestic and international customers including Hisense, Changhong, Huawei, Xiaomi, Skyworth, Samsung, LG, Sony, Sharp, Panasonic, SAIC, GAC, Cadillac, BYD, and Li Auto. Its products are used in consumer electronics, automotive displays and lighting, smart wearables, health monitoring devices, industrial control, and commercial displays. The company targets high-end display markets such as large-screen TVs, automotive intelligent cockpits, VR/AR devices, and smart home applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Wuhu, covering key domestic markets in South China, East China, North China, Southwest, and Northeast regions. It also has a subsidiary in Hong Kong for international trade and actively expands its global market presence, serving customers in Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Turkey, India, and other overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jufei operates in the midstream segment of the LED industry supply chain, specializing in LED packaging and component manufacturing. It procures raw materials directly from manufacturers and supplies finished LED components and modules to downstream customers including panel makers, consumer electronics brands, and automotive Tier 1 suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to enhance Mini/Micro LED technologies, automotive-grade LEDs, optical films, infrared LEDs, and semiconductor packaging. It collaborates with universities and industry partners to innovate in ultra-high-definition displays, smart automotive lighting, and optical sensing. Strategic initiatives include expanding automotive LED applications, developing high-performance backlight solutions, and advancing optical module technologies for data centers and AI applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of LED products and related components, including backlight LEDs, automotive LEDs, Mini/Micro LED modules, optical films, and semiconductor packaging products. The company also uses agency sales channels to supplement direct sales. Income is derived from product sales to domestic and international customers across multiple industries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jufei is a leading domestic player in backlight LED packaging in China, competing with global and regional companies such as Nichia Corporation (Japan), Seoul Semiconductor (South Korea), Everlight Electronics (Taiwan), Hongli Zhihui Group (China), Ruifeng Optoelectronics (China), Xinruida Technology (China), Zhaochi Optoelectronics (China), and Jingke Electronics (Hong Kong). The company holds a strong market position with growing global market share, especially in Mini LED and automotive LED segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.05 billion, a 21.54% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 339.6 million, up 47.63%. Total assets reached nearly RMB 6 billion, with net assets of RMB 3.7 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. The company maintains a healthy cash flow and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures exceeding RMB 204 million in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jufei emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and cost-effective LED products with advanced technology leadership in Mini/Micro LED and automotive-grade LEDs. Its products offer superior brightness, contrast, color accuracy, and durability, meeting stringent automotive and consumer electronics standards. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolios, and digitalized production to deliver customized, high-performance solutions that enhance customer value and support sustainable growth.
